title: Persistent Database Overload After Brief Network Glitch
description: A 5-second network partition occurred and recovered 30 minutes ago, but order-service and database remain completely overwhelmed with 100k queries/sec.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Clients and upstream services lack exponential backoff and jitter, creating a self-inflicted retry storm that keeps the database saturated after a transient blip.
key_evidence: Logs show repetitive immediate retries with retry_count=15 without backoff delay
Network metrics show the underlying network glitch lasted only from 17:29 to 17:30 UTC
distractors: Suspicion of external DDoS attack due to high traffic volume

logs.message: Transient network connection reset by peer
Switch port flap resolved, network latency normalized to 0.4ms
Database thread queue full: 100000 queued requests

order-service.author: lead_eng@orange.com
order-service.commit_message: Aggressive retry policy for mobile clients
